recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source work is recommended for FHIR-27916; any future generated Schematron problem for dom-3 should be handled as a generator or generated-output issue against the current FHIRPath-based source.
issue_request: FHIR-27916 was a Published FHIR-I technical correction, resolved Persuasive for R5, reporting that the Schematron implementation of the DomainResource dom-3 constraint was invalid and produced false-negative validation errors.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 676c239b025e7e82d436b28303ff996ffbdf19cb on master and 01b32044da05a02f9b69b194ca02b0d95e581c9d on R4B. Those commits changed source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml so dom-3's XPath iterated over each f:contained element and tested references against that contained resource's id.
additional_context: DomainResource remains a current build-scope artifact in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 removed XPath usage from DomainResource constraints, so the old Schematron XPath source that FHIR-27916 corrected is no longer present. Later applied issue FHIR-43690 refined the remaining FHIRPath expression for R6 and is already represented on the combined branch by commit d4c361a5158736a5d7b37283f6b0b8f352157981.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current authoritative DomainResource source has dom-3 as a FHIRPath expression, carries condition dom-3 on DomainResource.contained, and has no DomainResource XPath entries to patch.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue refined the same DomainResource dom-3 FHIRPath invariant for R6 and is already audited on the combined branch.
